text:
Predicates:
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorkLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
CSDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
Instructed(x, y) ::: x is instructed by professor y.
WorkingLab(x) ::: x is working in the lab.
Premises:
¬∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkLibrary(x) → CSDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ PartTimeJob(x) offeredByUniversity(x) → WorkLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakeDatabaseCourse(x) → CSDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ Instructed(x, david) → TakeDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkingLab(x) → Instructed(x, david)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(james) ∧ WorkingLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(PartTimeJob(jack) offeredByUniversity(jack) ∨ WorkingLab(jack)) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Student(james) ∧ PartTimeJob(x) offeredByUniversity(x)) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
